localization.TOURS.FellowshipDescription: Learn how the Fellowship shares themes and tags with every Hero.
localization.TOURS.FellowshipIntroContent: The Fellowship is a shared Actor for the whole group. Each world has one Fellowship, and every Hero is linked to it.
localization.TOURS.FellowshipSheetContent: Add a fellowship theme with power tags, a weakness tag, and a Quest. You can also add story themes and story tags.
localization.TOURS.FellowshipSetupContent: Drop a fellowship themebook here to create the Fellowship's theme. Use it to define the group's title, power tags, weakness tag, and Quest.
localization.TOURS.FellowshipSyncContent: The Fellowship's theme and tags appear on every Hero sheet. Changes to the Fellowship are shown there automatically.
